summary: Build digital health strategy and implementation skills with roadmaps, governance tools, and scorecards. Enrol to plan and deliver with confidence.
lede: Digital health strategy and implementation connects health-system priorities with the planning and delivery of digital services. For professionals in health transformation, informatics and programme delivery, it addresses the practical task of turning strategy into coordinated implementation. Learners practise assessing maturity, prioritising initiatives and building roadmaps, alongside designing governance and interoperability plans and tracking progress with implementation scorecards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for you if you already work in health transformation, digital health, informatics, or programme delivery and need to turn strategy into implementation. It is especially useful when you are responsible for planning, coordination, adoption, governance, or reporting across multiple health stakeholders.
outcomes: Health Data Privacy and Cybersecurity Evaluation
prerequisites: No specialist technical background is required beyond working knowledge of healthcare programmes or digital transformation work. You will benefit most if you can relate the exercises to a live service, implementation, or governance challenge from your organization.
